name: HI Mobility Berhad
overview: 今年公司完成收购 Acacia Motor Services 与 Handal BCM，并将主要业务多元化至商用车制造、组装、分销、销售及维修领域；同时 Handal Indah 与 Global Sustainable Transport Innovation and Knowledge Centre 签署谅解备忘录，探索交通科技领域的潜在合作。
overview_en: During the year, the company completed the acquisitions of Acacia Motor Services and Handal BCM and diversified its principal activities to include manufacturing, assembly, distribution, selling, maintenance and repair of commercial motor vehicles; meanwhile, Handal Indah signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Global Sustainable Transport Innovation and Knowledge Centre to explore potential collaboration in the transportation technology sector.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成两项收购并多元化业务至商用车制造、组装、分销、销售及维修领域。
segments.note_en: Completed two acquisitions this year and diversified into manufacturing, assembly, distribution, selling, maintenance and repair of commercial motor vehicles.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 收购 Acacia Motor Services 与 Handal BCM 及业务多元化事项于当日完成，代价通过发行及配发代价股份全数支付。
actions.text_en: The acquisitions of Acacia Motor Services and Handal BCM and the diversification were completed today, with the purchase consideration fully settled via the issuance and allotment of consideration shares.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 收购 Acacia Motor Services 与 Handal BCM 的买卖协议所有先决条件于 2026 年 4 月 1 日达成或获豁免。
actions.text_en: All conditions precedent under the sale and purchase agreements for the acquisitions of Acacia Motor Services and Handal BCM were satisfied or waived on 1 April 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Bursa Securities 批准为收购 Acacia Motor Services 与 Handal BCM 及业务多元化事项发行 34,385,068 股新股并上市。
actions.text_en: Bursa Securities approved the listing and quotation of 34,385,068 new shares to be issued pursuant to the acquisitions of Acacia Motor Services and Handal BCM and the diversification.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 全资子公司 Handal Indah Sdn. Bhd. 与 Global Sustainable Transport Innovation and Knowledge Centre 签署谅解备忘录，探索交通科技领域的潜在合作。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Handal Indah Sdn. Bhd. entered into a Memorandum of Understanding with Global Sustainable Transport Innovation and Knowledge Centre to explore potential collaboration in the transportation technology sector.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 完成收购 Acacia Motor Services 与 Handal BCM，并将现有主要业务多元化至包括商用车制造、组装生产、分销、销售、维护及维修。
model_changes.text_en: Completed the acquisitions of Acacia Motor Services and Handal BCM and diversified the existing principal activities to include manufacturing, assembly production, distribution, selling, maintenance and repair of commercial motor vehicles.
